title: Operator withdrawal
source: MA6094 Week 12 Guide - change event posted in class chat (even last digit of matriculation number)
text: Date: 6 April 2027. The only respondent to the Active Ageing Centre operator EOI has withdrawn, citing uncertainty about opening dates. There are currently no other respondents. The grant condition on signed operator agreements is unchanged. The Finance Director requests a change impact note before the April committee meeting.
